# Third party sources

`MPITraits.h` is taken from tandem, commit
<https://github.com/TEAR-ERC/tandem/commit/555bbfa06aad688d609cfa2fae6b5bc2e2315589>.
The GMSH parsers in `src/meshreader` are derived from the tandem GMSH
parser of that commit and of commit
<https://github.com/TEAR-ERC/tandem/commit/565ba7ba8aeb02eba2c5773f68119d01d41a82de>.
